title: Recursive Sum
statement: Implement `solve(value)`. Sum every integer in a nested list. An integer returns itself. An empty list returns 0. Lists contain only integers and lists.
hints: The integer case returns the integer.
The list case returns the sum of the recursive results.
Do not use a global accumulator you forget to reset.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The sum of a nested list is the sum of the sums of its children, and the sum of a number is the number.

editorial: The sum of a nested list is the sum of the sums of its children, and the sum of a number is the number. That recurrence does not need a flattened copy. A global accumulator also works and is easier to get wrong across calls.
